captions.detailed: A de Dion rear axle assembly consisting of a long, black tubular beam split in the center by a black boxy universal coupling block. At each far end of the beam is a grey wheel hub mounted onto a spindle flange. The hubs are designed to spin freely via revolute joints, allowing the wheels to rotate relative to the stationary axle beam.
captions.instruction: Generate a parameterized de Dion rear axle assembly. It should feature a central black rectangular coupling block joining two tubular black axle beams. At each outer end, mount a grey wheel hub assembly on a spindle flange, using revolute joints to allow the hubs to rotate.
captions.factory: Construct the main axle beam using cylinders for the tubes, and a combination of box and cylinder primitives for the central universal coupling block. For the wheel hubs, model a multi-stage cylinder to represent the flange and the central spindle cap, then array small cylinders to simulate mounting bolts. Assemble these components as an articulated object, defining revolute joints between the stationary axle spindles and the rotating wheel hubs.
